entities.summary: Salman Hussaini Nadwi is an Indian scholar and professor in the Islamic sciences. He is an author of numerous scholarly works in Arabic and Urdu. Salman Nadwi served as the Dean of the Faculty of Dawah at the Darul Uloom Nadwatul Ulama madrasa in Lucknow.
